card.name: Fixed phrases in boxed warnings
card.fires_on: The comma after 'burning' in the neuropathy symptom list, and the word 'a' after 'NSAID may cause' in the renal prostaglandin warning. Both sit inside repeated label sentences.

modes.label: Neuropathy symptom list
modes.description: The comma after 'burning' in the list of peripheral neuropathy symptoms in fluoroquinolone warnings.
modes.example: Discontinue moxifloxacin immediately if the patient experiences symptoms of peripheral neuropathy including pain, burning<<,>> tingling, numbness, and/or

modes.label: NSAID renal warning
modes.description: The word 'a' after 'may cause' in the NSAID renal perfusion warning.
modes.example: In these patients, administration of an NSAID may cause<< a>> dose-dependent reduction in prostaglandin
